# Advanced Deep-Learning Experiment

*Generated by `python main.py advanced` on 2026-11-12 22:35 (2.7 min on `cuda`). All numbers come from this run.*

## Set-up

- Same task, data and date split as the main LSTM: pollution inputs only, previous 14 days -> next-day AQI; train to 2019-09-30, validation to 2019-12-31, test after that (183 days).
- **Attention LSTM:** an LSTM whose additive attention layer weights each of the 14 days; the weighted summary and the latest day feed the output.
- **TCN:** three residual blocks of dilated causal 1-D convolutions (dilation 1, 2, 4).
- **Transformer:** 2 encoder layers, 4 attention heads, learned position vectors.
- **Quantile attention LSTM:** outputs the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles, trained with the pinball loss; the outputs are built so they never cross.
- Each model: 2 candidate settings (predict AQI directly or the change from today) x 5 seeds; the best mean validation score was chosen and saved to `models/advanced/selected.json` before the test period was scored once.

## Settings chosen on validation

| model | chosen setting | metric | validation (mean ± sd) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attention LSTM | change, 32 units | MAE | 31.26 ± 0.95 |
| TCN | level, 32 channels | MAE | 30.73 ± 1.11 |
| Transformer | change, d=32, 2 layers | MAE | 29.25 ± 1.16 |
| Quantile attention LSTM | level, 32 units | pinball | 10.76 ± 1.91 |

## Forecast intervals (80% range, quantile attention LSTM)

| period | actual AQI inside the range (target 80%) | mean range width (AQI) |
|---|---|---|
| validation | 82% | - |
| test (all) | 91% | 76 |
| test before 2020-03-25 | 85% | 100 |
| test, lockdown | 96% | 56 |

Test pinball loss: 6.07. A well-calibrated range contains the actual AQI on about 80% of days; much less means the model is over-confident.

The 3- and 7-day models reuse the setting chosen for 1 day; nothing was re-tuned.

## How to read these results honestly

- About two years of data and 458 training samples: large networks can easily memorise them, so a more complex architecture is not expected to win.
- Attention weights show what the network used, not what causes pollution.
- The test period contains the COVID-19 lockdown, unlike anything in training.
- One chronological split; small differences may not hold for other periods.
